title: Proper-surjective descent of constructibility on a vanishing topos
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], let $f:X\to S$ be of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. Let $F$ be any sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the vanishing topos $V_f$ [def-trf-oriented-nearby-cycles]. Suppose $p:T\to S$ is proper and surjective [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-surjective-morphism], and let $v:V_{f_T}\to V_f$ be the induced morphism for the Cartesian square $X_T=X\times_ST\to X$, $T\to S$, as in [def-trf-oriented-nearby-cycles]. If $v^*F$ is constructible on $V_{f_T}$, then $F$ is constructible on $V_f$, with constructibility in both places defined by [def-trf-oriented-constructible-sheaf].

source.place: Author draft, Lemma 9.1.5, printed p. 21: a sheaf on E=X left-oriented-product_S S is constructible if its inverse image on E prime=X prime left-oriented-product_S prime S prime is constructible, for S prime to S proper surjective. This is published Lemma 10.5, cited in Lu–Zheng, proof of Theorem 4.27(2), printed p. 37.

proof.text: Put $E=V_f$ and $E'=V_{f_T}$. Apply [lem-trf-proper-base-change-coherent-conservative] with the proper surjective map $p$ of the statement. Its hypotheses are exactly our Noetherian base and finite-presentation hypothesis on $f$. It gives coherent topoi $E,E'$ and a coherent conservative geometric morphism $v:E'\to E$. It also gives the Noetherian base $T$ and finite presentation of $f_T$, which will allow the constructibility criterion to be used on $E'$.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 9.1.5, printed p. 21, coherence and conservativity of the induced morphism; §8.1 for the coherent topoi.

proof.text: Let $A=|F|$ be the underlying sheaf of sets. All coefficients are the same finite constant ring $\Lambda$. The inverse image of a module over this constant ring is the ordinary exact inverse image with the transported operations, as stipulated in [def-trf-oriented-nearby-cycles]; hence $|v^*F|=v^{-1}A$. Apply [lem-trf-oriented-constructible-coherent] to $f_T$ and $v^*F$: the geometric hypotheses were supplied in Step 1 and the finite coefficient hypothesis is unchanged. The assumed constructibility of $v^*F$ therefore says that $v^{-1}A$ is a coherent object of $E'$.

source.place: §8.1, printed pp. 17–18, constructibility equals coherence, applied on the changed base.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-coherent-conservative-reflection] to $u=v$ and $A$. Step 1 supplies both coherent topoi and the coherence and conservativity of $v$; Step 2 supplies coherence of $v^{-1}A$. Thus $A$ is coherent in $E$. This is descent of an intrinsic finiteness property of $F$, and does not require any comparison theorem for nearby-cycle complexes.

source.place: §8.1, printed p. 17, coherence detected by coherent conservative inverse image; used in the proof of Lemma 9.1.5.

proof.text: Apply the reverse implication of [lem-trf-oriented-constructible-coherent] to the original $f$ and $F$. The original hypotheses give its Noetherian base, finite presentation, and finite constant ring. Step 3 supplies coherence of $|F|$, so the criterion gives finite stratifications of $X$ and $S$ on whose oriented products $F$ is locally constant with finite $\Lambda$-module values. This is precisely the requested constructibility.

source.place: §8.1, printed pp. 17–18, agreement of coherence and constructibility; conclusion of Lemma 9.1.5.

proof_origin.place: Agent-written expansion of the author draft Lemma 9.1.5 through its §8.1 coherence argument; primary source read online but not archived in literature/.

split_report.summary: Expanded the proper-surjective descent argument using the intrinsic coherence of underlying sheaves. Four statement-only children separate the coherence terminology, general conservative reflection theorem, constructibility/coherence comparison, and geometry of proper base change. The item statement and its hypotheses are unchanged. All new nodes were checked for DAG/blueprint duplicates and searched with logged Mathlib tools; no exact or one-line Mathlib match was found.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the proper-surjective constructibility-descent input in the conditional Psi-good nearby-cycle strata argument below lem-trf-local-term-locality, specifically the coherence-based argument of Orgogozo Lemma 9.1.5. The sk-i-curve-zero unit route is unchanged.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q42-a47cc2153 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read the item, all four new nodes and every cited statement in full. Orgogozo (author draft) is not archived locally, so I fetched it from the URL the item records and read §8.1 (pp. 17–18), §8.3 and Lemmas 9.1.1–9.1.5 (pp. 19–21). I also read Gabber travaux XI 2.4–2.5 for coherence of oriented products. The four steps follow the 9.1.5 proof exactly: (1) v is coherent and conservative; (2) |v*F| = v⁻¹|F|, by the constant-Λ exact inverse-image clause of def-trf-oriented-nearby-cycles, then constructible ⇒ coherent on V_{f_T}; (3) coherence is reflected along v; (4) coherent ⇒ constructible on V_f. All hypotheses are checked: S Noetherian and f of finite presentation give the qcqs schemes §8.1 needs, T is Noetherian by 01T6, f_T is of finite presentation by 01TS, and Λ is finite throughout. I proved the reflection lemma myself (finite subcover after u⁻¹, then conservativity on the image, for both quasi-compactness and quasi-separation). I checked point lifting for proper surjective p: a point of T over f(x̄) inside T×_S S_(s̄) specialises to the closed fibre. I checked that a locally constant underlying set sheaf with finite Λ gives a locally constant module. Small cases: identity, empty, zero module, infinite constant module, non-surjective p. No false statements, no restated clauses, no cycle, and no duplicates (rg over the DAG and blueprint main-20261015). Two fixes: def-trf-coherent-topos now cites def-trf-geometric-morphism and def-weil-pbc-topos instead of 'def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism after forgetting rings'; lem-trf-proper-base-change-coherent-conservative had a stale wrong tag 01TQ in blueprint.from.place, now 01TS. No tool_uses. The Orgogozo PDF should be archived in literature/.; 2 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
